t.5989-27-5.agn: A fragrance allergen: in a detergent, it must be named on the label above 0.01%. It oxidises on contact with air, which makes an allergic reaction more likely. In pure form, if swallowed and it enters the lungs, it can cause serious damage (H304).
t.5989-27-5.pw.0: A fragrance allergen; if you have a fragrance allergy, check the label for its name.
t.5989-27-5.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 601-096-00-2 (ATP17): Flam. Liq. 3, Asp. Tox. 1, Skin Irrit. 2, Skin Sens. 1B, Aquatic Acute 1, Aquatic Chronic 3.
t.5989-27-5.reg.det: Fragrance allergen: in a detergent, it must be named on the label above 0.01%.
t.5989-27-5.reg.ulke.TR: Türkiye SEA Regulation Annex 6 (Official Gazette 10.12.2020), index no 601-029-00-7: Flam. Liq. 3, Skin Irrit. 2, Skin Sens. 1, Aquatic Acute 1, Aquatic Chronic 1. Difference from the EU: in the EU but not here: Asp. Tox. 1, Skin Sens. 1B, Aquatic Chronic 3; here but not in the EU: Skin Sens. 1, Aquatic Chronic 1.
t.5989-27-5.summary: A fragrance ingredient and solvent found in orange and lemon peel oil.
t.5989-27-5.what: Gives the product a citrus scent and dissolves grease.
